items.quote: And they assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month, and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.
items.claim: A census was conducted on the first day of the second month using demographic categorization (families, houses, age 20+) as the counting mechanism.
items.mechanism: demographic census by families, houses, names, age filtering (20+ years)
